text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Super Spicy Gourmet" and "Favorite Events", huh~
Yes, both sound like wonderful column themes, don't they!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's teach the overseas folks who want to come to Tracen Academy lots of fun things about Japan!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¡Bueno! We'll make it a column so amazing that the Chairwoman who asked for it will shout "¡Ah!" in sheer shock!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿¡Qué!? K-Kris S-senpai?
This is... what a sinister aura...!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Kris, are you still having trouble deciding on a theme too?
Truth be told, I'm having a hard time picking one as well, you know?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahh, I see!
So that's what was going on!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's walk!
Let's all look for things that feel very Japanese together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of Japan, it's all about "Wa"! 
I just love ringing the bell rattle gara-gara!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well... Kris S, what are you looking at?
Maybe... a ghost!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Or perhaps――Kris is curious about the rattle too?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! Well then Kris S, let's ring it gara-gara together!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: When you think of Japan, it's gotta be "Hot Springs"!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to it, Kris!
Let's warm up heart and soul until we're all toasty and poka-poka~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah... let's get... poka-poka.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew, my throat is kara-kara dry! Let's take a break, then get back to searching for themes!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Theme... is――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, you've already decided, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...¿¡Qué!? You decided on a theme!?
Kris S-senpai too!? When did that happen!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
About "Various Japanese Manners"!
And Kris... is doing "About Japanese Onomatopoeia", right?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Yeah... "Onomatopoeia".
"Gara-gara"――"Poka-poka"――
They always――strangely, linger in the ear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But――How?
I didn't tell you――and yet... how did you know.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... that's been happening all day, hasn't it!?
You've been guessing exactly what Kris S-senpai wants to say!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Could it be that Fine is... psychic?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪
You caught me!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Just kidding.
In truth――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Kris is just very, very easy to read!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Is that――really so...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So~ very much so♪
That's why――
Stopping by a sporting goods store one day, I spotted some familiar faces.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will take this one!
Kris S-senpai, thanks for the advice!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! Just like Fine said, asking Kris S was the right call!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No problem――it was nothing.
I was thinking... about thanking everyone.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But... I didn't tell her――this either.
Is she truly――psychic?
